title: Tesla Just Dropped "Full Self-Driving" in Europe
description:
Tesla's European websites now call its driver-assistance system "Tesla Assisted Driving" after Germany's transport ministry said the old name was misleading.
Two myths busted: it still needs a supervising driver, and Europe hasn't banned it - the Netherlands approved it in April and Germany backs EU-wide approval.
